Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
